description: A winder stair whose first riser rises onto the first winder - its first flight has no tread - and whose last winder rises onto the floor at its head: 1 riser before the turn, 3 winders and 4 risers in all, each 675 mm. Its walkline starts at the first nosing line and ends at the head, on the turn's arc: a quarter of a circle of 450 mm, with no straight part.
